name: telekinetic thrust
desc: At 7th level, you can deliver a telekinetic shove with your Psionic Strike. When you deal damage to a target with your Psionic Strike, you can force the target to make a Strength saving throw against a DC equal to 8 + your proficiency bonus + your Intelligence modifier. If the save fails, you can knock the target prone or move it up to 10 feet in any direction horizontally.
